linkedin.article_body:
In 2026, software teams are discovering a brutal reality: autonomous coding agents powered by single LLMs suffer from compounding hallucination drift.

When an agent hallucinates a subtle parameter on line 42, subsequent reasoning steps build upon that false premise until the entire architecture is poisoned.

At Zoth Studio, we introduced Consensus Arena v2 — a multi-agent Byzantine arbitration engine that operates directly on your local workstation.

Key Architectural Breakthroughs:

1. Multi-Model Heterogeneity: Rather than querying the same model 3 times, we evaluate proposals from disparate weights (e.g., Claude 3.7, Grok-3, and Hermes 3 70B via Ollama).
2. Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) Convergence: Proposals are parsed into abstract syntax trees. Only structural intersections with 100% syntactic parity proceed.
3. Shannon Entropy Gating: We calculate token variance entropy H(X) = -Σ P(x) log2 P(x). If entropy exceeds 0.35, the models enter an autonomous debate loop until mathematical quorum is reached.
4. Zero Disk Pollution: No file is touched until the quorum signature is verified.

The result? Over 1,400 complex refactors with zero hallucinated API regressions.

Read the implementation breakdown on GitHub: https://github.com/NullAITech/zoth-studio
